estilo: Clean minimal 3D render, soft studio lighting, deep navy blue background (#0F172A), cobalt blue (#1D4ED8) and pale periwinkle (#C7D7FE) accents, subtle glossy materials, shallow depth of field.

imagenes.prompt: Two identical small glossy periwinkle flower pots side by side on a dark navy table. In the left pot a tall healthy young tree with many leaves; in the right pot only a tiny sprout with two leaves. Same soil, same pots, calm soft light.

A tall elegant glass hourglass on a dark navy table, instead of sand small silver coins fall from the top bulb into the bottom bulb, where a small green plant is growing out of the pile of coins, soft cobalt rim light.
The same two periwinkle pots years later: the left one now holds a big lush tree twice the height of the small tree in the right pot. Gentle warm hopeful light.
